# Band9AI Guides

> Public explainers from BAND9AI HUMAN SYSTEMS INC. about why an IELTS band stalls, how Writing criteria are averaged, and how a practice estimate differs from an official score. Mocks, pricing, and checkout are on https://band9ai.com.

Band9AI is not affiliated with the British Council, IDP Education, or Cambridge. Practice estimates are not official examiner marks.

## Guides

- [Why candidates stay at Band 6–6.5](https://band9ai.org/): How the overall band is averaged and rounded, and why one weaker skill keeps the result in place.
- [Which Writing criterion caps the score](https://band9ai.org/writing-criterion-cap.html): Task Response, coherence, vocabulary, and grammar are averaged inside each task. Task 2 weighs more than Task 1.
- [Practice estimate vs official IELTS score](https://band9ai.org/practice-estimate.html): What Band9AI's published 94.2% calibration figure measures, and what it does not claim.
